description: Search for vehicles with active rebates/incentives across ALL J.C. Lewis stores. Filter by model (e.g. 'F-150', 'Expedition') and condition (NEW/USED). The `store` argument is only a PREFERENCE that surfaces that store first — results always span the whole group because J.C. Lewis cross-sells. Returns pricing breakdown, incentive details, and the store each vehicle is at.
name: search_vehicles_with_rebates
